content.text:
I fixed the products page: the "New" and "Sale" labels on the product cards were cut off, and now they show in full.

**Cause:** the labels are placed to stick out past the card's top-right corner, but all cards are set to hide anything outside their edges (`.card { overflow: hidden; }` in `site/css/components.css`). Only small slivers of "New" and "Sale" were showing. The git history has only the initial commit, so I couldn't see which change introduced this. I found it by taking screenshots of the page.

**Fix:** I added a rule in `site/css/pages.css` so product cards no longer hide overflow. It affects only product cards:

```css
.card.product {
  overflow: visible;
}
```

I didn't remove the setting for all cards because the home page's feature card needs it. That card already sets it itself, so it isn't affected either way. The product images keep their rounded corners because they're rounded directly.

**Checked:** at desktop width (1280px) both labels are fully visible after the change. At mobile width (390px) the labels have enough room to fit, but I only screenshotted mobile before the fix, not after. All 16 functional tests pass. Nothing is committed.

STATUS: DONE
